decision.Steve: Initially proposed physical queue reorder, then supported separate plan to preserve canonical order and duplicates. Implemented shared planner and snapshot guard; reviewed integration and raised repeated-cycle history ambiguity.
decision.Elena: Independently proposed separate plan. Implemented Queue projection; final source review supports explicit browser-song selection policy and found no blocker.
decision.Morgan: Canonical queue plus50/10 bounded plan and actual-play history, persisted occurrence indices, exact history-slot selection and stable removal row keys. Root integrated player, storage boundary and native verification.

method: Disposable actual Electron main/preload/built renderer at1280x720 and100% zoom, synthetic localhost Jellyfin with130 occurrence queue including duplicate song ID. Actual encrypted connection/local-state saves reopened across processes. Snapshot mutations tested through real IPC; malformed disk snapshot and unavailable server songs tested at restore. Real decoded silent WAV seek just before endpoint produced natural media ending for repeat-one. External fetch blocked and counted; no user/provider mutations.
intermediateFindings: Index-dependent Queue React keys lost the Remove focus handoff; keys now use canonical occurrence plus ordinal among repetitions.
Repeat-all history can include prior-cycle occurrences outside current visited set; snapshot guard preserves that history and validates current membership.
Forward history can share a canonical key with a later cycle plan; projections and history-slot selection distinguish them.
Enqueue into empty shuffled player now initializes current history instead of persisting an invalid empty history.
limits: No unit framework/tests added. No full-library discovery, live service delivery, audible quality or VoiceOver acceptance.
Existing DJ-boundary continuations share the same Next route and were source-reviewed; no new native scheduled DJ-after-ending scenario claimed.
No large100000-occurrence performance benchmark; batch sampling limits random draws but collects remaining candidate keys.
